title: codex exec --output-schema usage
body:
# codex exec --output-schema usage

- Pass the schema file via `--output-schema <path>`.
- Every property must appear in `required` (Codex quirk); model optional fields as nullable types and keep them in `required`.
- Prompt goes as the final positional arg.
- `-o <path>` writes the raw JSON body to disk (no fences).
- Combine with `--sandbox read-only --skip-git-repo-check` for automation.
rationale: captures Codex's strict all-properties-required schema quirk + standard invocation flags
